trace: Native de/error.rs:1036–1039 stores std::io::Error in IOError and 1067–1076 stores Box<Error> in WithSnippet; de/error.rs:2233 provides an empty std::error::Error implementation with no source() override. A generic std::error::Error source-chain walk therefore uses the standard default and does not expose those inner fields through source(); named variants and retained typed value may still permit explicit matching, and Display rendering may still preserve diagnostic text.

The inspected first-party from_str adapters already stringify at their own boundary, and from_str takes a string, not a reader. No project consumer walking this native Error source chain or actual relevant IOError/WithSnippet reachability is shown.
